point: 本文的核心贡献是一个从高维观测(如图像)学习机器人技能、且无需手工设计奖励函数的框架,用少量成功结果样例加少量二值主动查询替代奖励工程。
quote_en: The primary contribution of this paper is a framework for learning robotic skills from high-dimensional observations, such as images, without hand-designing reward functions. Our method uses a small number of examples of positive outcomes (without demonstrations), followed by a modest number of additional binary active queries, where the robot asks the user if a particular outcome is successful or not.

point: 方法把奖励指定问题转化为训练一个分类器区分目标/非目标观测,并用分类器的成功对数概率 log pg(y|s) 作为强化学习的奖励。
quote_en: If the classifier provides a distribution pg(y|s), then a particularly convenient form for the reward is given by log pg(y|s).

point: 朴素分类器奖励容易被RL策略钻空子:策略会到达分类器没训练过的状态并骗它输出成功标签。
quote_en: the policy can learn to exploit the classifier, reaching states that are different from those that the classifier was trained on and fool it into outputting a success label erroneously

point: RAQ的主动查询机制是:在自上次查询以来的所有状态里,挑分类器判定成功概率最高的未标注状态去问用户,而非用最大熵不确定性启发式。
quote_en: we found that the most effective mechanism to select which states to label was to select the previously-unlabeled states with the highest probability of success according to the classifier

point: 查询状态选取公式为 k = arg max log pg(y=1|st),对自上次查询以来的所有 t 取最大。

point: 选最高成功概率而非最大熵的理由:负样例通常比正样例好得多,且分类器被钻空子是因假阳性而非假阴性,只有正预测状态才可能是假阳性,所以查这些状态能有效缓解钻空子。
quote_en: because the policy is explicitly trying to visit states with high pg(y|s), classifier exploitation is due to false positives rather than negatives [13]. Since only states with positive predictions can be false positives, querying for labels for these states is an effective mechanism for mitigating classifier exploitation.

point: 查询按固定间隔进行,据期望训练长度和查询预算来定频率;真实机器人实验里每次运行做25到75次主动查询。
quote_en: we adjust the frequency so that we make between 25 to 75 active queries for a single run of a reinforcement learning experiment.

point: 作者把VICE扩展到off-policy:用SAC优化最大熵目标,并从replay buffer直接采负样例、丢掉重要性权重(理论与实践上对抗IRL可丢)。
quote_en: prior work has observed that adversarial IRL can drop the importance weights both in theory [10] and in practice [22]. We adopt the same approach, and sample negative examples for the discriminator directly from R without importance weighting.

point: 为免用户提供动作标签,作者对正样例的动作用当前策略 π(a|s) 积分掉(从 π(a|sE) 采动作),收敛时与用户给真值动作有相同不动点。
quote_en: we remove the need for the user to specify actions by integrating out the actions for the positive examples in the VICE discriminator update, by using the current policy π(a|s).

point: VICE-RAQ把RAQ的主动查询加进VICE:查询为正就把该状态加入正样例集,查询为负则无需加(VICE本就把所有采样状态当负样例)。
quote_en: To integrate RAQ with VICE, we simply add the active queries, as in Algorithm 3, and append the labeled state to the example set if the label is positive. If the label is negative, there is no need to append the state, since VICE already uses all sampled states as negatives.

point: 策略、critic和奖励函数 fψ 用同一CNN架构:两层卷积(各接最大池化,仿真任务每层8个滤波器、真实任务每层32个),展平后两层各256单元全连接,卷积与全连接后用ReLU。
quote_en: It consists of two convolutional layers, each of which is followed by a max-pooling layer, with 8 filters in each of the convolutional layers for simulated tasks, and 32 filters per layer for real world tasks. The flattened output of the convolutional layers is followed by two fully-connected hidden layers with 256 units each.

point: 实验用7自由度Sawyer机械臂、末端执行器位置控制,观测为84×84的RGB图像,不使用关节角或末端执行器位置。
quote_en: we use end-effector position control on a 7 DoF Sawyer robotic manipulator, and our observations consist of an RGB image of size 84 × 84. We do not make use of robot joint angles or end effectorpositions.

point: 在三个真实任务(视觉推杯、视觉盖布、视觉插书)上,成功率按10次试验平均:VICE-RAQ三项全部解决,而VICE和RAQ各只在部分任务成功、在另一些任务失败(表中数字为 VICE-RAQ 100/100/100、RAQ 60/100/0、VICE 0/100/60、朴素分类器全 0)。
quote_en: In all cases, VICE-RAQ succeeds at learning the task, while VICE and RAQ succeed at some tasks while failing at others.

point: 视觉推杯任务中VICE-RAQ得100%而RAQ仅60%,off-policy VICE和朴素分类器都失败,说明主动查询和利用RL数据都有帮助。
quote_en: For this task, VICE-RAQ obtains a success rate of 100%, while RAQ only obtains a success rate of 60%. Both off-policy VICE and naïve classifier fail to solve this task.

point: 视觉插书任务里RAQ单独无法解决、off-policy VICE只是偶尔成功,只有VICE-RAQ稳定解决。
quote_en: we see that RAQ alone is unable to solve this task, while off-policy VICE learns a policy that only succeeds sporadically. The policy learned with VICE-RAQ solves this task consistently

point: 视觉盖布任务里只用末端执行器3D位置加手工欧氏距离奖励的基线失败(只走直线无法盖布),说明这类可变形物体任务需要靠视觉关注布的形变。
quote_en: We observe that this baseline fails to solve the task (see Figure 7). This indicates that performing this task requires the robot to actually pay attention, visually, to the deformations in the cloth, in order to perform the draping successfully.

point: 各任务规模:每任务给80个成功样例;推杯6.2K步(约90分钟)做25次查询,盖布25K步(约4小时)做50次查询,插书19K步(约3小时)做75次查询。
quote_en: We provide 80 success examples each for the pushing, draping and book placing tasks. We query once every 250 timesteps for the pushing and book placing task, while querying once every 500 timesteps for the draping task. The Visual Pusher experiments are run for 6.2K timesteps (about 90 minutes of real world time), the Visual Draping experiments are run for 25K timesteps (about 4 hours), and the Visual Bookshelf experiment is run for 19K timesteps (about 3 hours).

point: 整个方法只需1-4小时真实世界交互,作者称这远少于先前工作。
quote_en: and with only 1-4 hours of interaction with the real world.

point: 相比从人类偏好学习的工作:Christiano等在低维仿真中约做一千次人类查询、需上千万步交互,而本文在真实世界只做50-75次查询、约数万步交互。
quote_en: Even in simulation with lowdimensional observations, Christiano et al. [4] make about one thousand queries from humans (we make 50-75 such queries in the real world), and require tens of millions of timesteps of interaction with the environment (we require around tens of thousands of such interactions).

point: 插书任务展示分类器比目标图像更有表达力:方法学到根据书的起始位置把书插进最近的空槽(因为这样能最大化分类器奖励),而用目标图像会总插进固定的某个槽。
quote_en: our method learns a policy to insert the book in different slots in the bookshelf depending on where the book is at the start of a trajectory. The robot usually prefers to put the book in the nearest slot, since this maximizes the reward that it can obtain from the classifier.

point: 作者自述局限:仍需用户提供标签(引入额外假设);每次训练约50次查询仍非平凡;方法不利用任务间的共享结构。
quote_en: First, the requirement to obtain labels from the user imposes additional assumptions. Second, the number of queries required—around 50 per training run—is still non-trivial. ... Lastly, our method does not benefit from any shared structure between tasks.
